text: {"lessons":["Selling winners felt satisfying, but locking in gains did not tell me whether the stocks were good investments; I should decide based on future risk and return, not the comfort of a realized profit.","I bought stocks again after selling them, sometimes at different prices; I should avoid letting regret or a desire to undo past decisions drive trades.","With random price changes, a few months of results are not evidence of a reliable pattern. I should trade infrequently and keep diversification and my overall plan in focus."]}
